name: Koz
overview: The topic of Koz, also known as Hakkoz, centers on a priestly family head and their descendants, who are mentioned in Ezra and Nehemiah. Scripture records that the children of Koz were notable among the priests but faced exclusion from full priestly duties due to defective genealogies. Despite this, descendants of Koz actively participated in the physical and spiritual restoration of Jerusalem, as evidenced by Meremoth, a son of Urijah from Koz's line, who helped repair sections of the city walls. This highlights both the honored priestly heritage and the challenges faced by Koz's lineage in post-exilic Israel.
